description: Checks the DNS TXT ownership record of a custom domain and, when it matches, marks the domain verified for this account. Call get_domain_verification first for the record, have the user add it at their DNS provider, then call this until it reports verified (a new record can take minutes, sometimes hours, to show). A verified domain can be bound: dname on deploy_app/deploy_compose, dns_entries on create_instance, or set_cluster_domain. A pending claim's TXT value can change (values are specific to each account), so add exactly the value get_domain_verification returns now, never one saved earlier or seen on another account; if verify_domain keeps failing, call get_domain_verification again and update the record when the value differs.

domain.description: The custom domain to verify ownership of (e.g. app.example.com).

name: verify_domain
title: Verify custom domain
